profile.name: Neeraj Kumar
profile.role: I am a university student learning backend development and systems engineering.
profile.introduction: I am currently learning how APIs, databases, servers, and reliable systems work together. I learn best by building projects, testing ideas, and improving them one step at a time.
bio: Right now, I am learning about API design, databases, server-side development, reliability, and the foundations behind scalable systems.
I am still early in my journey, so I use projects as a way to understand how real products are designed, built, and maintained. I enjoy learning in public and improving through hands-on work.

projects.title: DECS.DO
projects.summary: An intelligent, zoomable workspace canvas designed to help people organize tasks and stay focused.
projects.description: DECS.DO brings task planning, focus sessions, ambient audio, and AI-assisted organization into one customizable workspace. Its infinite canvas lets users pan, zoom, resize, and arrange modular tools to match the way they work.
highlights: Infinite canvas with draggable, resizable productivity widgets
AI-assisted task organization with an Eisenhower priority matrix
Pomodoro focus tracking, daily streaks, and ambient audio streams
Cloud authentication and workspace synchronization with Supabase
